job.title: Software Developer
job.content:
Responsibilities:


1. Develop and maintain web applications using Laravel and PHP

2. Build backend features, admin panels, CRUD modules, and APIs

3. Work with MySQL or PostgreSQL databases

4. Fix bugs and improve existing systems

5. Assist with frontend integration using Blade, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, or Bootstrap

6. Write clean, readable, and maintainable code , follow current sturcture

7. Use Git for version control

8. Work closely with the team to complete assigned tasks


Requirements:


1. Minimum 6 months of hands-on Laravel development experience

2. Basic understanding of Laravel MVC, routes, controllers, models, migrations, and Blade

3. Basic knowledge of MySQL or PostgreSQL

4. Familiar with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and jQuery

5. Able to debug errors and read Laravel logs

6. Responsible, willing to learn, and able to follow instructions

7. Good problem-solving attitude
